name: timon-plugin-discord
description: Talk to a Timon agent from Discord: direct messages and chosen channels, one mission per day, question cards.
author: FlorentBL

timon.label: Discord conversation
timon.description: Chat with a Timon agent from Discord (DM and chosen channels). Reads Discord over REST, answers the owner only, relays agent replies and question cards.
timon.author: FlorentBL

settings.label: Enable the conversation (reads Discord every few seconds)
Bot token (stored sealed by Timon; used first when set)
Or: vault entry holding the bot token, granted to agent:plugin:discord
Discord server id (used to find the owner when no owner id is set)
Discord user id allowed to talk to the agent (default: owner of the server)
Agent that answers (default: the main agent)
Server channel ids to listen to, comma separated (DM is always on)
Time of day (HH:MM) at which a new daily conversation starts
Time zone for the daily rollover (IANA name)
